Join our team as an AI Engineer working on retrieval-augmented generation for enterprise search. You will write Python every day, call OpenAI-compatible APIs, store vectors, and ship features behind FastAPI. We also use TypeScript on the frontend, Docker for local stacks, and PostgreSQL for metadata. Ideal candidates have shipped production ML or LLM features and can explain tradeoffs clearly. Remote-friendly within UTC+7 to UTC+9.
